name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: Security hardening. Pool notices require authenticated membership and untrusted roster URLs no longer trigger automatic friend requests or sharing. Internal relay keys are memory-only; friend HTTP responses are bounded and redirects/proxies are disabled. Playback tokens are bounded and rate-limited, and disabling a friend revokes existing access. Pairing and direct links enforce exact peer/endpoint binding and replay protection; viewer reports, segment caches and playlist URLs are hardened. Pairing remains review-locked. Includes everything in 0.0.203.
